name: b1_global20_kd_lr001_e3_int8
what_we_did: B1: global 20% channel pruning (magnitude, isomorphic, round_to 8; -36% params), 3-epoch KD recovery (lr 0.001, cosine, MPS); then static QDQ int8 (per-channel, Percentile 99.99, S8S8, 300 calibration images, re-calibrated)
result_type: local measurement (ours, not an organizer-provided number)

method.input: one image per inference, shape (1, 3, 224, 224); random values for timing, real images for accuracy
method.accuracy: top-1 over one pass of the evaluation set, Section 4 preprocessing
method.latency: mean of 100 timed inferences after 10 warm-up inferences
method.peak_ram: highest process RSS, sampled every 10 ms during the timed inferences (psutil)
method.energy: codecarbon over 15 s of back-to-back inferences, divided by the inference count

machine: Apple M3 Pro, 11 cores, 18 GB RAM, Darwin 25.4.0, CPU only
